OSLogEntry.doc: A single entry from the unified logging system.

OSLogEntryActivity.doc: An entry generated by an activity event.

OSLogEntryBoundary.doc: The metadata that partitions sequences of other entries.

OSLogEnumerator.doc: An enumerator that can access and list log entries.

OSLogMessageComponent.doc: The message arguments for a particular entry.

OSLogPosition.doc: A representation of a point in a sequence of entries in the unified logging system.

OSLogStore.doc: A set of entries from the unified logging system.

OSLogEntryFromProcess.doc: A protocol that defines subclasses containing metadata about a process.

OSLogEntryWithPayload.doc: A protocol defining subclasses that represent entries made using a handle and a format string.

OSLogEntryLogLevel.doc: The log level at which the entry was generated.

OSLogEntryStoreCategory.doc: A classification of how the entry was to be stored and rotated at the point when it was created.

OSLogEnumeratorOptions.doc: Option to control the direction of the iteration.

OSLogMessageComponentArgumentCategory.doc: The data type corresponding to the argument provided in a message payload.

+localStoreAndReturnError:.doc: Creates a log store representing the Mac’s local store.

+storeWithURL:error:.doc: Creates a log store based on a log archive.

-entriesEnumeratorAndReturnError:.doc: Returns a log enumerator with default options for viewing the entries.

-entriesEnumeratorWithOptions:position:p.doc: Returns a log enumerator based on an underlying store.

-positionWithDate:.doc: Returns a position representing the time specified.

-positionWithTimeIntervalSinceEnd:.doc: Returns a position representing time since the end of the time range that the entries span.

-positionWithTimeIntervalSinceLatestBoot.doc: Returns a position representing time since the last boot in the series of entries.

OSLogEntryStoreCategory.doc: A classification of how the entry was to be stored and rotated at the point when it was created.

composedMessage.doc: The fully formatted message for the entry.

storeCategory.doc: The current log entry’s storage tag.

parentActivityIdentifier.doc: The identifier of the parent activity.

OSLogEntryLogLevel.doc: The log level at which the entry was generated.

level.doc: The log level of the entry.

OSLogEnumeratorOptions.doc: Option to control the direction of the iteration.

OSLogMessageComponent.Argument.doc: An object representing data that corresponds to an argument in a message payload.

OSLogMessageComponentArgumentCategory.doc: The data type corresponding to the argument provided in a message payload.

argument.doc: The argument passed into the message component.

argumentCategory.doc: The type of argument that corresponds to the placeholder.

argumentDataValue.doc: The argument formatted as a sequence of bytes.

argumentDoubleValue.doc: The argument formatted as a double.

argumentInt64Value.doc: The argument formatted as a signed 64-bit integer.

argumentNumberValue.doc: The argument formatted as a number.

argumentStringValue.doc: The argument formatted as a string.

argumentUInt64Value.doc: The argument formatted as an unsigned 64-bit integer.

formatSubstring.doc: The text immediately preceding a placeholder.

placeholder.doc: The placeholder text for the message component.

getEntries(with:at:matching:).doc: Returns a sequence of log entries filtered by the parameters passed in.
